title: Mongo-sharded: chaos process-kill a shard mongod + RS rejoin
description: Runs `nexus chaos mongo-sharded process-kill`: kills nexus-mongo on a shard SECONDARY (the safer target), observes the shard drop to 2/3 (still majority), then auto-lifts + confirms the cluster recovers to green.

observe.what: observed impact: the victim shard shows quorum 2/3 up during the kill (still majority, no data loss); cluster recovered=true after lift

observe.where: ssh victim node: systemctl status nexus-mongo
observe.what: service killed then restarted; member rejoins the RS as SECONDARY

whatProves: MongoShardedAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync pushes the embedded nexus-chaos.sh, process-kills a shard secondary, captures the degraded-but-available impact, and verifies self-healing back to green.
